title: Game Jam: 48-hour indie game sprint
description: A weekend game jam to prototype a playable game from a mystery theme. Solo or teams welcome — bring a laptop and an idea, and mentors will be on hand for art, code and playtesting.
author: WDCC Game Dev Club

title: Game Art Bootcamp: sprites & animation
description: A practical workshop on creating game-ready art — character sprites, tilesets and simple walk-cycle animation in Aseprite. Bring a tablet or mouse; beginners welcome and all assets are yours to keep.
author: Pixel Garden Studio

title: Hackathon Kickoff: build a project in 24 hours
description: A 24-hour hackathon to build something useful or fun — web apps, bots, hardware, or art installations. Pitches start Saturday morning, demos Sunday night, prizes for best overall, best design and most creative.
author: CHCH Hack Society
